okanran-examples.ifa

Okanran: Assertion and Panic

Defensive programming with assertions and explicit error raising.

Use Case 1: Input Validation with Assert

// validate.ifa - Validate function inputs

ese divide(a, b) {
    Okanran.sise(b != 0, "Division by zero");
    pada a / b;
}

ese set_age(age) {
    Okanran.sise(age >= 0, "Age cannot be negative");
    Okanran.sise(age <= 150, "Age exceeds maximum");
    Irosu.fo("Age set to " + age);
}

// Usage
set_age(25);
set_age(-5); // will assert

Use Case 2: Panic on Invalid State

// panic.ifa - Raise errors on invalid conditions

ese connect_db(host, port) {
    Irosu.fo("Connecting to " + host + ":" + port + "...");

    ti (port < 1) {
        Okanran.kigbe("Invalid port: " + port);
    }

    Irosu.fo("Connected");
}

ese read_config(path) {
    ti (!Odi.wa(path)) {
        Okanran.kigbe("Config not found: " + path);
    }

    ayanmo content = Odi.ka(path);
    Irosu.fo("Config loaded (" + Ika.len(content) + " chars)");
}

Use Case 3: Precondition Checks

// preconditions.ifa - Guard clauses with assert

ese process_order(item, quantity) {
    Okanran.sise(item != null, "Item is required");
    Okanran.sise(quantity > 0, "Quantity must be positive");

    Irosu.fo("Processing " + quantity + "x " + item);
}

ese lookup_user(id) {
    Okanran.sise(id >= 1000, "Invalid user ID range");

    Irosu.fo("Looking up user " + id + "...");
}

// These will pass
process_order("Laptop", 2);
lookup_user(1001);

// These will fail assertion
// process_order("Mouse", 0);
// lookup_user(500);
